Pricing Strategy 2026

# Pricing Strategy 2026

We ship three tiers: Solo ($29/mo), Team ($99/mo), Scale ($299/mo). Solo includes 1 company, 100 autonomous runs/month. Team adds approvals + multi-seat. Scale adds custom agents + SSO.

Key decision: anchor on outcome-based pricing (autonomous runs) instead of seat-based to capture leverage.
